ToolboxElements.Name: Text placeholder
ToolboxElements.Description: Outputs the first format parameter as text.

ToolboxElements.Name: Multiple values
ToolboxElements.Description: Outputs the first two format parameters separated by a vertical bar.

ToolboxElements.Name: Date (German)
ToolboxElements.Description: Formats a DateTime parameter using a German-style date and 24-hour time.

ToolboxElements.Name: Date (ISO 8601 round-trip)
ToolboxElements.Description: Formats a DateTime parameter using the ISO 8601 round-trip format.

ToolboxElements.Name: Boolean
ToolboxElements.Description: Outputs a Boolean parameter as True or False.

ToolboxElements.Name: Number (2 decimals)
ToolboxElements.Description: Formats a numeric parameter with grouping and two decimal places.

ToolboxElements.Name: Currency
ToolboxElements.Description: Formats a numeric parameter as currency using the current culture.

ToolboxElements.Name: Percent
ToolboxElements.Description: Formats a numeric parameter as a percentage with two decimal places.

ToolboxElements.Name: Literal braces
ToolboxElements.Description: Outputs the first format parameter enclosed in literal braces.
